steps.label: Actuals landed: October GL + KIS census
Completeness DMFs per feed
steps.result: KIS census 71% — 23 clinics missing discharge records

steps.label: Fallback: rebuild census from HL7 ADT archive
Reconcile: care days × daily rate vs payer billing

bots.name: Variance Explainer
bots.tagline: Splits the revenue variance into care days, daily rate and payer mix, and writes commentary grounded only in those numbers.

steps.label: Care-day / daily-rate / mix bridge by country × facility type
steps.sql:
SELECT country, facility_type,
  (act_care_days - fc_care_days) * fc_rate   AS volume_eff,
  (act_rate - fc_rate) * act_care_days       AS rate_eff,
  mix_eff, act_revenue - fc_revenue          AS rev_var
FROM SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_CARE_DAY_BRIDGE WHERE period = '2026-10';
steps.result: Revenue EUR 103.9M vs forecast EUR 104.7M · occupancy 87.0% vs 87.4% · largest driver: Acute occupancy in Germany

steps.label: Rank top 5 drivers (|effect| ≥ EUR 0.2M)
steps.sql: SELECT * FROM SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.CARE_DAY_BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 2e5 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
steps.result: 5 drivers selected — Acute care days, Bad Sonnfelde occupancy, CH insurer rates, agency cost, ALOS

steps.label: AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
steps.result: Commentary drafted (176 words) · numeric check: 10/10 figures match bridge

steps.label: Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
Draft commentary to Executive dashboard + P&L
steps.result: Draft published (badge: Written by Variance Explainer)

guardrails.label: Grounding
guardrails.rule: Every figure in the text must exist in the bridge result

guardrails.label: Materiality
guardrails.rule: Only drivers above threshold are explained

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_VARIANCE_EXPLAINER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 2}'
AS
  CALL SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('variance-explainer');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Care-day / daily-rate / mix bridge by country × facility type
SELECT country, facility_type,
  (act_care_days - fc_care_days) * fc_rate   AS volume_eff,
  (act_rate - fc_rate) * act_care_days       AS rate_eff,
  mix_eff, act_revenue - fc_revenue          AS rev_var
FROM SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_CARE_DAY_BRIDGE WHERE period = '2026-10';
-- step 3 · Rank top 5 drivers (|effect| ≥ EUR 0.2M)
SELECT * FROM SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.CARE_DAY_BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 2e5 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
-- step 4 · AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
SELECT AI_COMPLETE('claude-sonnet-4-5',
  'Write CFO commentary using ONLY these figures: ' || OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*)::STRING)
FROM SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.CARE_DAY_BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5;
-- step 5 · Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
SELECT SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.FN_NUMBERS_GROUNDED(:commentary, 'CARE_DAY_BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5');
-- step 6 · Draft commentary to Executive dashboard + P&L
INSERT INTO SDP_VITREA_TEASER.PUBLIC.REPORT_NARRATIVE_LOG (page, text, source) VALUES ('executive', :commentary, 'SNOWBOT:variance-explainer');

Roll RF: actuals Jan–Oct + ML Nov–Dec

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_ROLLING_FORECAST
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS
  CALL SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('rolling-forecast');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Retrain SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST per facility type × country
CREATE OR REPLACE SNOWFLAKE.ML.FORECAST SDP_VITREA_TEASER.PUBLIC.M_CARE_DAYS_FC(
  INPUT_DATA => TABLE(SDP_VITREA_TEASER.PUBLIC.V_VITREA_ML_TRAIN), SERIES_COLNAME => 'series',
  TIMESTAMP_COLNAME => 'month', TARGET_COLNAME => 'care_days');
-- step 3 · Guardrail: backtest MAPE ≤ 5%
CALL SDP_VITREA_TEASER.PUBLIC.M_CARE_DAYS_FC!SHOW_EVALUATION_METRICS();
-- step 4 · Roll RF: actuals Jan–Oct + ML Nov–Dec
CALL SDP_VITREA_TEASER.PUBLIC.SP_ROLL_FORECAST(source_version => 'Q3F', new_version => 'RF10', actual_through => '2026-10');
-- step 5 · Promote RF10 to current forecast (approval)
CALL SDP_VITREA_TEASER.PUBLIC.SP_PROMOTE_VERSION('RF10', approved_by => :approver);

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_GL_MAPPER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  SCHEDULE = 'USING CRON 0 6 * * * Europe/Berlin'
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS
  CALL SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('gl-mapper');

-- step 1 · Unmapped accounts detected
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SDP_VITREA_TEASER.PUBLIC.V_UNMAPPED_ACCOUNTS;
-- step 2 · AI_CLASSIFY against group COA
SELECT account_code, AI_CLASSIFY(account_name || ' ' || sample_postings,
  (SELECT ARRAY_AGG(account_name) FROM SDP_VITREA_TEASER.PUBLIC.DIM_ACCOUNT)) AS mapping
FROM SDP_VITREA_TEASER.PUBLIC.V_UNMAPPED_ACCOUNTS;
-- step 3 · Guardrail: confidence ≥ 0.92 auto-apply, rest to Inbox
SELECT * FROM SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence < 0.92;
-- step 4 · Apply mappings + DMF on unmapped balance
INSERT INTO SDP_VITREA_TEASER.PUBLIC.MAP_GL_TO_PLAN SELECT ... FROM SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence >= 0.92;

bots.name: Occupancy Sentinel
bots.tagline: Daily bed occupancy check per clinic; quantifies revenue at risk below the 85% threshold.
bots.trigger: Stream on KIS daily census snapshot

steps.label: Occupancy by clinic × facility type
steps.sql:
SELECT clinic, facility_type, care_days / NULLIF(available_bed_days, 0) AS occupancy
FROM SDP_VITREA_TEASER.PUBLIC.VITREA_CLINIC_MONTHLY WHERE month = '2026-09-01' AND version = 'ACTUAL';
steps.result: Group 88.5% · 3 clinics below 85%: Bad Sonnfelde 78.4%, Bergquell 81.3%, Lindenmoor 82.2%

steps.label: Revenue at risk vs 85% threshold (Nov–Dec)
steps.sql: SELECT SUM((0.85 - occupancy) * available_bed_days * revenue_per_care_day) FROM SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_OCCUPANCY_RISK WHERE occupancy < 0.85;

steps.label: Draft admissions-referral actions
steps.result: Draft: DRV referral push for 3 clinics, owners assigned

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_OCCUPANCY_SENTINEL
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  SCHEDULE = 'USING CRON 0 6 * * * Europe/Berlin'
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 2}'
  WHEN SYSTEM$STREAM_HAS_DATA('SDP_VITREA_TEASER.PUBLIC.STR_GL_JOURNAL')
AS
  CALL SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('occupancy-sentinel');

-- step 1 · Occupancy by clinic × facility type
SELECT clinic, facility_type, care_days / NULLIF(available_bed_days, 0) AS occupancy
FROM SDP_VITREA_TEASER.PUBLIC.VITREA_CLINIC_MONTHLY WHERE month = '2026-09-01' AND version = 'ACTUAL';
-- step 2 · Revenue at risk vs 85% threshold (Nov–Dec)
SELECT SUM((0.85 - occupancy) * available_bed_days * revenue_per_care_day) FROM SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_OCCUPANCY_RISK WHERE occupancy < 0.85;
-- step 3 · Draft admissions-referral actions
CALL SDP_VITREA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.SP_DRAFT_REFERRAL_ACTIONS(threshold => 0.85, horizon => '2026-12');
